subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Chaste
solution:
The correct answer is: **Corrupt**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chaste** means innocent and pure in thought and act.

 
 
• **Example -** *He remained **chaste** his whole life.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Corrupt** means having or showing a willingness to act dishonestly in return for money or personal gain.
 
 
• **Example -** *He had accused three opposition members of **corrupt** practices.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Chaste'** and '**Corrupt'** are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vicious** means deliberately cruel or violent.
 
• **Cruel** means wilfully causing pain or suffering to others, or feeling no concern about it.
 
• **Virtuous** means having or showing high moral standards.
